title: How Can I Change My Overwhelm?
fullTitle: Soul Snack #56: How Can I Change My Overwhelm?

promo.text: Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here .

description: By examining how emotions are freestanding energies that arise within, Gary helps listeners identify overwhelm as a fear-based part of their personality. The practice of noticing these sensations in your body, experiencing them fully, and responding with healthier qualities like gratitude or patience is how you create authentic power. This inner mastery frees you from being controlled by fear and allows you to consciously shape your own experiences.

When you choose to respond from love – rather than react from fear – you begin to dissolve the causes of your overwhelm. What was once a cycle of stress and avoidance becomes an opportunity for growth, gratitude, and conscious creation.

This week, notice moments when you feel overwhelmed. Instead of trying to fix external situations, pause and look inward. Ask yourself: What am I feeling in my body right now? What fear might be underneath this? Then consciously shift your focus to gratitude, patience, or appreciation. Each time you do this, you create authentic power and take one step closer to freedom from overwhelm.
